name: Buckley Creek Recreation Area
note: Little Blue NRD recreation area on a 20-acre flood-control lake (trolling motors only, 5 mph), off 561st Ave 1 mi E and 1/2 mi N of Reynolds; its west arm is mostly marsh. The electric sites line a gravel pull-off on the north side of the park loop, on a mowed slope above the tree-lined south shore; tent camping on the north shore, and a nine-hole sand-green golf course run by a local association shares the grounds. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Little Blue NRD recreation page (littlebluenrd.org/recreation/, read 2026-11-05): '6 camper hookups ($15 per night fee; effective May 1, 2021) ... and plenty of tent camping', 'public rural water, restrooms' + LBNRD Daily Camper Fees Schedule (effective May 1, 2021): Buckley Creek '$15.00 per night for 30/50 Amp Electrical Camper Sites' + Buckley Creek Site Specific Rules (updated July 2026) 03.01A camping 'permitted in the areas designated, as per the attached map', the map marking 'Electrical Hookups' at the SW park loop + Esri Wayback 2020-06-11 and 2025-11-11 (WV02, z19): a ~60 m x 15-20 m gravel pull-off on the loop's north side (built 2016-2020), and the 2010-08-12 capture shows travel trailers parked along that same stretch + The Dyrt review 2025-06-07 (camper, electric site, 'only camper there') + Campendium reviews 2020-09-17/18 (two nights, electric $10 then) + Google Maps 5.0 on 5 reviews -> real NRD drive-in RV campground. Public (local): no price gate.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-05: Esri Wayback 2020-06-11 (WV02, z19, rendered, high water), 2025-11-11 (WV02, z19, rendered), 2016-08-10 and 2010-08-12 (z19, rendered) plus World Imagery export (rendered) at 40.06868,-97.31027: the electric pull-off sits on the north edge of the park loop, with ~25-40 m of mowed grass sloping down to a shore treeline that is continuous along this stretch in every capture (2010, 2016, 2020); open water ~60 m N (40.06925,-97.31027) behind those trees, and the lake's west arm next to the camp is marsh/cattail (dark on the NRD map and 2025 frame). A continuous treeline screen and the distance rule rule out an on-water value, and no capture or photo shows an open sightline from the pads -> not waterfront (unsure goes down; no per-site map exists, the NRD map only labels 'Electrical Hookups'). USGS 3DEP: 431.5 m at the pads, 429.8 m 25 m N, 424.6 m at the treeline and on the open water (pads ~7 m above pool, under the shore canopy height). Lake 20 acres (NRD), so a lake not a pond. Dam check: the earthen dam is the diagonal embankment on the lake's NE side (~40.0711,-97.3062), ~400 m NE across the water; the pads are upstream on the lake side and above pool, not below the dam.

fees.note: $15 a night for a 30/50-amp electric camper site (schedule effective May 1, 2021, still the one linked in 2026); tents on those sites at no extra charge. Pay within 30 minutes of set-up; permits expire 6 pm the next day. No annual park permit required.

fees_source: https://littlebluenrd.org/wp-content/uploads/Daily_Camper_Fees_Schedule_2021.pdf, read 2026-11-05: 'Buckley Creek Recreation Areas, Jefferson County $15.00 per night for 30/50 Amp Electrical Camper Sites. (Tents may be erected at such sites without additional charges.)'; 'No Annual Park Permits are Required.'; NRD recreation page '6 camper hookups ($15 per night fee; effective May 1, 2021)'. The only RV class is electric, so only that class is priced (shape copied from 15614 Liberty Cove).
booking_source: https://littlebluenrd.org/wp-content/uploads/Final-07_14_2026-Park-Rules-Regulations.pdf, read 2026-11-05: '01.05C Campsites are provided on a first-come, first-served basis.'; '01.05I Camping is permitted for a maximum of fourteen (14) consecutive days on any single area during any thirty (30) - day period.'
flags: Duplicate check: no entry named Buckley Creek or at Reynolds (grep 'Buckley' hits only 2881 Buckley Park Campground in Stromsburg (~118 km N), 11044 Cantrall Buckley Park (OR) and a Bruning Dam provenance string; 'Reynolds' no hits); nearest DB campgrounds are 2792 Crystal Springs Park (Fairbury, 11.7 km) and 2669 Alexandria SRA (18 km). No entry within 2 km. RV Life not checked (Campendium and The Dyrt list it).

4-vs-6 pads settled as 6 (sites.count 6): Wayback captures of littlebluenrd.org/recreation/ from 2018-12-05 through 2024-02-28 say '4 camper hookups' in the Recreation prose, and every capture from 2024-05-26 on (through the live page read 2026-11-05) says '6 camper hookups' - a deliberate edit in spring 2024. The 'four electrical camper pads' bullet is unchanged since 2018, so it is the stale line. Imagery can't count pedestals on the gravel pull-off; Campendium's 'Number of Sites 4' predates the change. AWH may prefer to leave count absent; a call to 402-364-2145 would settle it.

Pin is the gravel electric pull-off on the north side of the SW park loop (Esri 2020/2025), where the NRD map's 'Electrical Hookups' icon sits. Campendium pin 40.068197,-97.311289 is ~70 m SW on the same loop; Google pin 40.07017,-97.30716 is the lake/dam area ~350 m NE. Address 70670 561st Ave (Campendium). The SSR location (NW1/4 Sec 10 T1N R1E, 1 mi E and 1/2 mi N of Reynolds) fits: Reynolds geocodes to 40.05973,-97.33559.

The Dyrt's Buckley Creek page mixes in reviews of Buckley Park, Stromsburg (2022 review, water at every site, pull-throughs, dump) - ignored. Only the 2025-06-07 review (electric spots, quiet) is about this place.
Waterfront: went down to not waterfront like sibling 15614 Liberty Cove - the shore treeline screens the pads. A dated photo from a pad showing the lake would lift it to lakeview.

Structured data for stamping: hookups.electric 50 (fee schedule '30/50 Amp Electrical Camper Sites', read 2026-11-05; Campendium's '20 Amp' is an aggregator figure, ignored); water/sewer at site not stated (leave absent); sites.count 6 (NRD recreation page '6 camper hookups', read 2026-11-05; see the 4-vs-6 flag); max_rig_ft 40 (General Regulations 01.05K 'Camper units may not exceed 102" in width and forty (40) feet in length', approved 07/14/2026); pull-through: the sites are a pull-alongside gravel strip on the loop (Esri 2020/2025), not stated by the NRD - leave absent; booking reservable false, fcfs always, platform none, max_stay_nights 14 (General Regulations 01.05C/01.05I); facilities: potable_water true ('public rural water', NRD page), restrooms (vault per Campendium 2020-09-17; NRD map shows three restroom buildings), shelters, grills, limited playground, golf course; dump: none stated (leave absent); season not stated (leave absent).

Other rules (SSR July 2026): boating 5 mph, small trolling motors only (03.01D); water skiing banned (03.02A); no hunting or trapping, wildlife preserve (03.02C); golf area leased to the Buckley Creek Recreation Association (03.01H); snowmobiling in designated areas. Phone 402-364-2145 is the NRD office (Davenport).
